consequence.statement: The controller and webhook no longer emit the 'Neither --kubeconfig nor --master was specified' warning at startup; the release notes list this as a cleanup, with no operational impact.

assertion.statement: cert-manager 1.17.0 no longer logs the "Neither --kubeconfig nor --master was specified" warning when the controller and webhook start; this is a log cleanup and has no operational consequence.
